Subject: algebraic geometry | ID: 22204

Proposition

Step 3. Using the primitive regularization, we obtain \(V_{01370013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the real manifold.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via perturbative interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01370011 \cdot C_01370012 \cdot C_01370013\).
